description: This file defines the ProjectDao class, which handles database operations related to projects within the OrangeHRM system. It includes methods for saving, deleting, retrieving, and filtering projects, managing project assignment permissions, and generating various project reports. The class interacts with multiple entities such as Project, ProjectActivity, ProjectAdmin, and TimesheetItem, utilizing Doctrine ORM for database queries.

classes.name: ProjectDao
classes.description: Data Access Object class for managing project-related database operations within the OrangeHRM HRM system. Extends BaseDao to provide CRUD, filtering, reporting, and permission-related methods for Project entities.

methods.name: saveProject
methods.description: Persists a Project entity to the database and returns it.

methods.name: deleteProjects
methods.description: Marks multiple projects as deleted based on provided project IDs.

methods.name: getProjectById
methods.description: Retrieves a non-deleted project by its ID.

methods.name: getExistingProjectIds
methods.description: Returns IDs of existing, non-deleted projects from a list of IDs.

methods.name: getProjects
methods.description: Fetches a list of projects based on provided search filter parameters.

methods.name: getProjectsCount
methods.description: Returns the count of projects matching the search filter.

methods.name: isProjectNameTaken
methods.description: Checks if a project name is already taken for a specific customer, optionally excluding a specific project ID.

methods.name: isProjectAdmin
methods.description: Verifies if an employee is assigned as a project admin.

methods.name: getProjectIdList
methods.description: Retrieves list of project IDs, optionally including deleted ones.

methods.name: getProjectIdListForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Gets project IDs accessible by a given project admin, optionally including deleted projects.

methods.name: hasTimesheetItemsForProject
methods.description: Checks if there are timesheet items associated with a specific project.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Fetches project report criteria based on filter parameters.

methods.name: getProjectReportCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Returns the count for the project report criteria list.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration of timesheet entries for projects matching filter.

methods.name: getProjectActivityDetailedReportCriteriaList
methods.description: Retrieves detailed project activity reports based on filter.

methods.name: getProjectReportActivityDetailedCriteriaListCount
methods.description: Counts the number of detailed project activity report entries.

methods.name: getProjectReportActivityDetailedCriteriaList
methods.description: Provides a paginator for detailed project activity report criteria.

methods.name: getTotalDurationForProjectActivityDetailedReport
methods.description: Calculates total duration for detailed project activity report entries.

methods.name: getAccessibleEmpNumbersForProjectAdmin
methods.description: Returns employee numbers of employees accessible by a project admin.

methods.name: getUnselectableProjectIds
methods.description: Lists project IDs that are associated with timesheet items (and thus cannot be unselected).

methods.name: getActivityIdsOfProjectInTimesheetItems
methods.description: Retrieves IDs of project activities associated with a specific project within timesheet entries.
